subject.title: Feature: Respect userTimezone in memory file timestamps and naming

question: Should bundled session-memory filenames and `# Session` headers use `agents.defaults.userTimezone` instead of the shipped host-local/TZ behavior?
rationale: The remaining source-proven gap is narrow, but the behavior is a user-visible artifact naming contract and current docs/tests describe host-local session-memory output.

options.title: Use existing userTimezone
options.body: Make session-memory match the already-aligned memory-flush path by resolving `agents.defaults.userTimezone` for filenames and headers, with focused tests and docs updates.

options.title: Keep host-local session-memory
options.body: Treat host-local session-memory filenames/headers as the intended shipped contract and close this request as not planned.

options.title: Add a memory-specific timezone policy
options.body: Introduce a separate memory artifact timezone setting only if maintainers want memory to differ from both host-local and `userTimezone`, accepting the added config surface.

recommendation.title: Use existing userTimezone
recommendation.body: Make session-memory match the already-aligned memory-flush path by resolving `agents.defaults.userTimezone` for filenames and headers, with focused tests and docs updates.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice spans current session-memory code, memory-core flush behavior, and the repository's config-surface policy.
